summary: Post-refactor Part B regression (server.py splits + Admin.js/Tickets.js/Scanner.js modularization + useTeyaCheckout shared hook). Backend API sanity: 8/8 pytest pass. Frontend: all critical checkout flows work — Standard tier qty updates (499->998), apply-guard toast when submitting with unapplied promo, valid MZYPL5BKOD -> '−95% (list price 499 Kč)' with total 25 Kč, invalid promo (no crash), referral T5915F8 auto-applies with exactly ONE 'Discount applied — 50 Kč off per ticket' toast and total 449 Kč, Group modal (1 996 Kč, no quantity select), Gold modal (no promo, guests 4→7 595 / 6→9 393 / 14→16 585 Kč), Teya embedded container mounts with Czech card form (Zaplatit 25,00 Kč) for both Standard checkout AND /upgrade (STOPPED before card entry). /upgrade: unknown code -> 'Ticket not found', ATF-63BBC9 -> 'Pay upgrade — 400 Kč'. /vi/upgrade renders Vietnamese copy. Admin: all 7 tabs load, no infinite fetch loops, Overview shows category cards + revenue check + stats. Ambassador inline Edit shows Save/Cancel and Cancel closes cleanly. Scanner /nascanujtobrasko: valid ATF-63BBC9 -> VALID TICKET panel + door log entry; camera button labelled 'Start Camera Scan', doesn't crash in headless. No console runtime errors introduced by refactor.

issues: Filter dropdown labels ('5th Saigon', '6th Mainstream', '7th Seoul') are inconsistent with the per-card floor select labels required by spec ('Saigon Floor (5th)', 'Seoul Floor (7th)'). Also, '6th Mainstream' is included as an active filter option even though 'Mainstream Floor (6th)' is a legacy value that cannot be assigned (backend PUT /api/admin/messages/{id} correctly returns 400 for this floor, confirmed). Filter-only inclusion is defensible for browsing legacy records, but the label wording should be aligned across the two dropdowns.

backend_api.GET /api/admin/stats: 200; all required keys present: revenue_czk, tickets_sold, categories(standard/vip/vip_guest_list), revenue_check, ambassadors, per_tier
backend_api.note: Original spec used 'tier' key in /api/orders/create payload — actual schema requires 'tier_id'; test file adjusted accordingly. Behaviour otherwise unchanged.

critical_code_review_comments: Messages FILTER dropdown label wording ('5th Saigon' / '7th Seoul') diverges from the per-card floor select label wording required by spec ('Saigon Floor (5th)' / 'Seoul Floor (7th)'). Align both to the same style for consistency.
Recharts 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings still emitted from Overview chart before container gets first paint dimensions (flagged in previous report, still present).

Persistent React 19 hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — introduced by editor instrumentation injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option>. Non-blocking, but pollutes console.

Frontend continues to fire 4-5 x /api/gate/status 401 probes before login on /admin and /nascanujtobrasko — no functional impact, but adds console noise. Consider suppressing 401 log for auth-probe endpoints.
server.py /api/orders/create request body uses 'tier_id' (required); the review-request wording ('tier: standard') is stale — no code fix needed, doc only.
